tools.name: query_logs
tools.description: Run a CloudWatch Logs Insights query on log groups over a time range, for example fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message like /ERROR/ | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50. Returns the fields and rows, at most 500 rows, and a link to the query in the CloudWatch console.

account.description: The 12-digit AWS account ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one account.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 500. Default 100.

logGroups.description: Log group names, or the start of names followed by *, for example ["/ecs/checkout", "/aws/eks/prod/*"]. One query reads at most 50 log groups.

query.description: The Logs Insights query, passed to CloudWatch as given. Use limit or stats to keep the result small.

region.description: The AWS Region, for example us-east-1. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one Region.

since.description: The start of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

until.description: The end of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List the write events of CloudTrail event history in a time range, newest first: which API was called on which resources, by whom, and whether it failed, with a console link to each event. Read-only calls are left out.

account.description: The 12-digit AWS account ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one account.

eventSource.description: Only events of this AWS service, for example ecs.amazonaws.com.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 200. Default 50.

region.description: The AWS Region, for example us-east-1. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one Region.

resource.description: Only events about this resource, by name or ARN, for example checkout or arn:aws:ecs:us-east-1:111122223333:service/shop/checkout.

since.description: Only events at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: 24 hours before until.

until.description: Only events before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.
